reviews.reason: Executable alternate slices sent to Rules violate the work/constraint boundary. Separating standing policy from executable alternatives makes the repair coherent.
The catalog both preserves and repairs Protocol Apply sites that pass-orchestration-in-technique removes. The supported bind site is the coherent common remedy.

A source name or heading is not delivered evidence. The witness is restricted to operative references whose required text or value is unavailable; orientation and locally delivered references remain valid.

The phrase where the placeholder belongs can already exclude a comparison constant. Make that boundary explicit; this is a false-positive prevention improvement, not proof that all literal predicates violate the rule.

The same expression evaluated before and after a write can have different truth values. The exemption is insufficient to prove a producer dominates a read. A definedness repair must retain the domain predicate.
A sibling suffix alone does not establish the applicable naming family, and the broad content-name exemption overlaps the detector.

The existing final Detect test already requires undetermined behavior, so compatible cumulative rules do not reproduce a defect when the full test is applied. The useful change clarifies that grouping alone does not provide precedence.
reviews.proposed_fix_override: Retain the current undetermined-behavior test. Add to Do not flag: Compatible cumulative constraints. Replace the group-key exemption with grouping that makes scopes disjoint or explicitly establishes precedence; a label alone is insufficient.

reviews.reason: The bare-introduction exception and the whole-plus-section detector admit opposing dispositions for one delivered citation pair.

Keeping every reason is broader than retaining an operative constraint or fact. The fix should preserve necessary meaning and remove explanation that adds no obligation; this is a repair wording conflict, not a ban on useful context.

Repeated use of the same capability alone does not prove a useful shared technique contribution. The conflict occurs when extraction yields only a raw-return alias; different capabilities and a fixed-question wrapper are already exceptions. Do not claim every extraction cycles.
The entry already exempts external library callers and asks for a reader. Strengthen its name-search procedure to prove an actual route; do not treat a lack of visible external callers as unused.
The explicit Protocol-and-Rules lexical search misses input consumption in permitted Output recognition and artifact filename templates. Adding a bare mention is not a semantic repair.
